# AI Assistant Guidelines for blog.mikael.green

Purpose: Help quickly update and maintain a Hugo-based personal blog with minimal ceremony plus two Cloudflare Worker-style OAuth helper functions.

## Big Picture

- Static site generated by Hugo (see `config.yaml`) with a custom imported module/theme: `github.com/skaramicke/blog.mikael.green-theme`.
- Content lives in `content/` using mixed frontmatter styles (YAML `---` and TOML `+++`). Keep existing style per file; don’t convert formats.
- Two Cloudflare Worker entrypoints in `functions/` (`auth.ts`, `callback.ts`) implement GitHub OAuth (authorize + token exchange + popup postMessage back to opener). They are isolated utilities for an `/admin` Netlify/Static CMS style flow (see `static/admin/`).
- `go.mod` only pins Hugo themes as Go modules; no Go source code here—don’t add Go unless introducing a Hugo module feature.

## Key Directories

- `content/` : Posts & pages. `_index.md` files define section listing metadata.
- `archetypes/default.md` : Template for new posts (draft true by default).
- `static/` : Copied verbatim to site root (includes `/admin` UI and images referenced in posts).
- `functions/` : Cloudflare/Workers style TypeScript edge functions. Each exports `onRequestGet`.

## Content Authoring Conventions

- Preserve the existing frontmatter format per file (YAML vs TOML). Example: `content/post/1password-kubeconfig.md` uses YAML; `content/contact.md` uses TOML.
- Required fields typically: `title`, `date`, `draft` (default true via archetype), optional `categories`, `menus`, `description`.
- Do not auto-insert tags/categories unless clearly patterned in neighboring posts.
- Use relative image paths like `/images/...` matching files under `static/images/`.
- Keep manual `<!--more-->` marker if present—don’t remove or duplicate.

## OAuth Functions Pattern

- `auth.ts`: Builds GitHub authorize URL with `client_id`, `redirect_uri`, `state`, `scope`. Uses `crypto.getRandomValues` + helper `bufferToString` for state.
- `callback.ts`: Exchanges `code` for access token via POST to `https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token` (Accept: application/json). Renders a minimal HTML page that `postMessage`s `authorization:github:success:{token...}` back to `window.opener`.
- Keep interface definitions minimal and local; if extending, prefer extending existing `Env` or `EventContext` shapes rather than introducing external dependencies.
- Error handling: return simple `Response` objects with status codes; match existing approach (no new logging libraries).

## Adding New Functions

- File per route under `functions/` exporting the appropriate `onRequest<Method>` (e.g., `onRequestGet`). Follow the same inline interface pattern for lightweight type safety.
- Avoid large frameworks; keep dependencies zero for edge portability.

## Theming & Config

- Theme import configured under `module.imports` in `config.yaml`. To switch or add a theme, add another `imports` entry; don’t modify existing unless intentional.
- Site params: `logo_text`, `date_format`, etc.—add new params under `params:`; reference theme docs separately (not stored here).

## Don’ts

- Don’t introduce a build step for TypeScript; Workers environment supports the used syntax. If a build is required later, document it here.
- Don’t reformat or convert frontmatter types globally.
- Don’t add unused Go code—`go.mod` is for theme modules only.

## Quick Tasks Examples

- New post: create `content/post/my-topic.md` using archetype fields; set `draft: true` until ready.
- Publish draft: change `draft: false` and commit.
- Add new image: place under `static/images/` then reference via `/images/<name>`.

## When Unsure

- Mirror existing file patterns closest in scope.
- Ask for clarification before structural changes (themes, auth flow, build tooling).
